**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use covenant on Teleglobe USA Inc.

What I checked:
- Targeted searches for compete/competing business, "shall not" develop/market/sell, exclusivity, field-of-use/territory, and sole-source language — no covenant found. The single "exclusive" hit (p0262) is the dispute-resolution sole-and-exclusive-remedy clause.
- Full read of Paragraph 12 (Acquisition and Use of Capacity, p0186–p0214) and Paragraphs 15–17 (p0219–p0227), per the planner's flag to confirm nothing hides there.
- The two "restrictions" hits are affirmative freedoms in our favour: 12.20 (private IRU sales "without any restrictions") and 12.22 (Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "on any commercial basis without any restrictions").
- Paragraphs 15–17 run the other way, binding the Terminal Parties to provide transit facilities, connection and Direct Access, and pledging not to impede qualified Carriers (p0227).

Noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged: the Paragraph 12 eligibility/use conditions (12.1 capacity usable only by a carrier; 12.6–12.8 WAC correspondent conditions). These are mutual structural rules about capacity inside APCN 2, apply to every Party equally, are expressly relaxed by 12.15 and lifted by 12.20/12.22, and do not restrict the businesses we operate or the systems or capacity we may buy or build — so they fall outside the NONCOMPETE boundary rather than constituting a deviation.

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to flag terms that benefit our party.
